svg.text: BED v7 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Lay out the L and R head-box panels by their IDs; clamp each case on a flat surface.
2. Fit Head and Foot BETWEEN the two full-depth sides. Fit the raised Bottom inside.
3. Check equal diagonals before fastening. Fit the square lid with its 3 mm perimeter gaps.
4. Fit the selected lid hinges and stays only after checking their supplier template.
